No galaxies match these filters.

Depth = estimated 5σ point-source AB limit for the deepest single MAST observation in the best filter (sky-limited scaling of ETC reference values; ±0.3 mag; ignores crowding). Epochs = visits to the galaxy separated by more than 180 days. Baseline = longest time separation between two observations whose footprints overlap on the galaxy. Roman footprints: HLWAS/GPS tile maps from Sanderson et al. (2026, arXiv:2603.12981), HLTDS from the Survey Footprint Explorer; Euclid Wide is the published Region-of-Interest definition (|b| ≥ 23°, |β| ≥ 10°, E(B−V) ≤ 0.09), not the executed tiling.
